meta.title: Turlock Independent-Business Catalog (first-pass, public-web sourced)
meta.method: FACTORY turlock_biz_organizer methodology: 6-lens public-web sweep -> in-code dedup -> granular taxonomy categorization -> verification gate. Every entry carries >=1 source URL; national chains/franchises excluded. Authored via sub-agents.
meta.honesty: Per-business revenue is NOT in this catalog and is not public; it will only ever be added as a labeled benchmark estimate in the profiling step. This census is a FLOOR, not a ceiling.
meta.coverage_assessment: This is a public-web first pass and cannot be treated as a complete census of independent Turlock businesses; it is a floor, not a ceiling. No national chains/franchises were found in the catalog to drop (all entries are genuinely independent operators); the only removals were one duplicate (Tortilleria 3 Hermanos merged into Tortilleria Tres Hermanos) and twelve entries whose only 'source' was a generic search-results or category-aggregator URL (Yelp/UberEats search pages, a LocalHarvest farms list) that does not resolve to a verifiable business listing. After cleaning, 174 businesses remain across 76 categories. Note that La Perla Tapatia was retained but is a borderline case: it is a small family-owned regional mini-chain headquartered in Turlock (multiple Central Valley locations), so it is locally owned but not a single-location independent. Several retained entries also rest on weak sourcing (Instagram/Facebook/Linktree/Square pages, third-party directories like YellowPages, BBB, restaurantji, loc8nearme, ueniweb) and carry med/low confidence; they were kept because the source still identifies a specific named business, but a few may be defunct, relocated, or home-based rather than storefront (Lightly Used Books, for example, has already closed its physical location). Systematic under-counts are significant and skew by sector: (1) home-based and by-appointment-only businesses (in-home hair/nails/lash/esthetics, bookkeepers, notaries, freelance trades) are largely invisible to the public web; (2) mobile and pop-up operations - food trucks, taco trucks, pupusa carts, mobile detailers, mobile mechanics, event florists - are badly undercounted here precisely because their only listings tend to be the generic search pages we had to drop, so real, operating trucks were almost certainly removed as unsourced; (3) non-advertising legacy businesses with no website or social presence (older trades, immigrant-owned markets, sole-proprietor professional offices) never surface; (4) anything behind bot-blocked or paywalled directories is missing - notably the Turlock Chamber of Commerce member directory and the Downtown Turlock / shopdowntownturlock.com and Visit Turlock sites, which 403 automated fetches, so the most authoritative local rosters could not be mined; (5) language and platform bias means Spanish-, Assyrian-, Punjabi-, and Portuguese-language businesses that advertise primarily by word of mouth or on community Facebook groups are underrepresented relative to their real prevalence in Turlock. Categories most likely under-counted: food trucks/taco trucks, pupuserias, panaderias/carnicerias, barbers, nail/lash/brow studios, in-home cleaners, and independent trades (handyman, painting, roofing, fencing, pool service) that barely appear here at all. Treat category_counts as lower bounds; the true independent-business population of Turlock is materially larger than 174.

lens_coverage_notes.note: Strong coverage of downtown Turlock core (Main/Center St) independent retail across apparel boutiques, men's/formal, antiques/vintage, jewelry, home decor/gifts, florists, thrift/consignment, and books. National chains (Old Navy, HomeGoods, Goodwill, Dollar Tree, Safeway floral) were excluded. The shopdowntownturlock.com directory and townsquarepublications.com shopping page both returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so a few additional listings on those directories could not be fully enumerated; addresses were cross-confirmed via Yelp/Turlock Journal/business sites instead. Lightly Used Books' physical storefront closed March 2025 (now online-only) - retained with med confidence. Studio A Vintage and Vintage Thrift are lower confidence (limited corroboration / partly photography or off-core locations). 'Intrinsic Elements' was mentioned in one aggregator but could not be source-confirmed, so it was omitted. Florists like James Cress/Avas/Hand Creations appear to be delivery-network/national listings and were excluded as not clearly independent local storefronts.

Ran 10 targeted searches covering restaurants, taquerias, cafes/coffeehouses, bakeries/panaderias, food trucks, ice cream/dessert, downtown dining, Assyrian/Mediterranean, pizza/Italian, and mariscos/pupusas. Captured 48 sourced independent food businesses. Excluded national chains/franchises that surfaced (Starbucks, Baskin-Robbins, Cold Stone, Papa Murphy's, Pizza Factory, Pizza Guys [franchise], Mountain Mike's, MOD, Figaro's, The Walking Taco catering franchise). Borderline notes: Camp 4 Wine, Atrium, Mariachis, Las Casuelas, Villa Napoli marked med confidence since sources tie them to Turlock and local ownership but with less explicit independence detail. Many food trucks came only from Yelp/aggregator listing pages (low confidence) — names confirmed present on the source page but limited independent corroboration. Pizza Factory is a franchise chain (excluded) despite the '40 years hometown' marketing. Rancho Fresco and Commonwealth were mentioned as incoming but not yet open/confirmed, so omitted. Could deepen with Downtown Turlock association directory and Turlock Chamber member list for more independents (e.g., First & Main, Bistro 234 corroboration), and individual food-truck verification.

Strong coverage across all target ethnic segments tied to Turlock: Assyrian/Middle Eastern (Nineveh Imports, International Bazar, Neesan Market, Ishtar), Portuguese/Azorean (Corvelos Bakery), Mexican carnicerias/tortillerias/panaderias/mercados (La Rancherita, La Morenita, Tres Hermanos x2, Los Compadres, San Miguel, La Perla Tapatia), and South Asian/halal/Afghan (Shah Groceries, Turlock Halal Market, Halal Market and Food). EXCLUDED for being outside Turlock: Habibi's International Market (Manteca per its own Facebook), Guru Indian Grocery (Modesto), Annapurna Indian Grocery Market (Merced). Punjab Express was excluded as it is a restaurant, not a grocer/market. La Perla Tapatia marked independent=true but med confidence because it is a 5-store regional family chain (borderline on the 'non-chain' rule, though locally owned and Turlock-HQ'd). Several names surfaced only as Yelp/aggregator list mentions without a dedicated Turlock-specific source URL (Mayar's Halal Meat & Grill, Middle East & Afghan Market, Carniceria Michoacan, Trujillos Meat Market, Mi Carniceria, Las Tarascas, Diana's Bakery, Village Fresh Market, Indian Bazaar, Nagina Palace) and were therefore not recorded as standalone entries. Addresses pulled from search-snippet text; recommend verifying street numbers against Google profiles. Did not deep-fetch the Chamber of Commerce directory which could add more.

Strong coverage of the auto_trades lens. Excluded national chains/franchises surfaced in results: Midas, Les Schwab, America's Tire, Walmart, Lowe's, NAPA, AutoZone, O'Reilly, Southern Tire Mart, Gerber Collision, Caliber Collision, Fix Auto USA, dealership body shops (Bonander GMC, Smith Chevrolet), Roto-Rooter, Knights Plumbing & Drain (multi-region), and Tri County Flooring America (Flooring America franchise). Carquest Auto Parts (430 Lander Ave) was omitted as a national-brand franchise despite local ownership; verify if you want it as independent=false. Smog stations (All Valley, Speed Pass) and several detailers/landscapers/cleaners are sourced via aggregators (Yelp/SmogTips/HomeGuide) rather than primary sites, hence med confidence. Likely additional independents named in result snippets but lacking a direct URL in my results (not included per no-source rule): Benil's Garage, Tom Richards Electric, Del Rio Electric, Kirkes Electric, Koehn Electric, Wally Falke's, Comfort Experts, Loves Air, Revive Auto Detailing, AutoSpa209, Clutch & Transmission Technicians, Purity Cleaning. A follow-up pass targeting each of these by name would likely confirm them. No primary Chamber of Commerce / Downtown Turlock directory page surfaced for this lens; a dedicated Chamber search could add corroboration.

Ran 15 targeted searches across all lens sub-areas (hair/barber/nails/tattoo/spa/med-spa, chiropractic/dental/optometry/PT/gyms-studios, accounting/insurance/real-estate/notary). Captured 65 independent businesses, each with a real source URL. Excluded national chains/franchises encountered: Great Clips, Ulta, The Joint Chiropractic, Jackson Hewitt, Liberty Tax, Nationwide/Liberty Mutual agent listings, RE/MAX, Coldwell Banker, Dimov/Aesthetic-Lab-style multi-region were kept only where clearly local owner-operated. Some confidence=med entries rely on social/Yelp/aggregator sources rather than an own site; their Turlock location is clear but independence is inferred. Med-spa entries (Advance Med Spa, La Belle, Aesthetic Lab) are multi-location regional but appear locally/physician-owned rather than franchised. A few names surfaced in search summaries without a discrete source URL (e.g., The Mane Lounge, Salon Reinvented, Renu Salon & Spa, Just Life Financial Services, La Belle Medical Spa) were omitted for lacking a clean dedicated source tying them to Turlock. Further searches (massage, esthetics suites, individual Booksy/Vagaro listings, Downtown Turlock directory) would likely surface more solo practitioners.

Strong coverage across the lens: feed/farm supply (2 independents + Stanislaus Farm Supply co-op; excluded Tractor Supply as a chain), dairy/ag-support (TDR, Dairy Solutions Group, Sallaberry Pump), large-animal/dairy vets (Lander, Mid Valley, Azores), bike (Cycle Masters), music (Hendrickson's, Dale's, Ingram's), florists (De La Fleur, Yonan's, Flowers By Eva), wholesale/commercial bakery (Sunrise, Mary Ann's), and small food production (Cipponeri honey, Nourish Farm). EXCLUDED chains: Tractor Supply, Petco, Pet Supplies Plus, Walmart pet, Safeway floral. Coffee roasters were thinner than hoped — Chatz Roasting is physically in Ceres (excluded), and Milone Coffee could not be tied to a clear Turlock address via a primary source so it was omitted; Rise N Brew included as a likely-independent coffee shop with house roast. A local Turlock olive oil producer appeared in a Turlock Journal headline but the specific business name was not surfaced, so it was not recorded. Several entries (vets, TDR, florists) corroborated via their own sites; aggregator (Yelp/YP) sources used where no primary source surfaced. Confidence reflects how clearly the source ties the business to Turlock and to independent ownership.
